subject: Authorize EU inference backfill — req creation and interview slate
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Authorize EU inference backfill — req creation and interview slate

Hi Markus / Marissa / Laura,

Requesting approval to open a formal requisition to backfill the EU-facing inference role (replacing Rishi Malhotra). Recruiting has a strong shortlist from Acme Talent and we need to lock headcount and interview panel before we schedule onsite loops.

Quick summary: 
- Role: Principal Inference Engineer (individual contributor, IC5-equivalent) — EU timezones prioritized
- Business reason: hands-on serving/runtime ownership to close the operational gap for EU customers; coverage needed for Dedicated/Private onboarding workstreams
- Proposed level & band: IC5 / L6-equivalent, target OTE range provided in attached headcount form
- Hiring type: backfill (headcount already in org chart but needs greenlight for req creation)
- Timeline: goal to complete loop + offer within 4–6 weeks if we move now

Attachments: headcount_request_form_8342.pdf, JD_principal_inference_engineer_v3.docx, candidate_pack_alex_v1.pdf
Greenhouse draft: https://redwood.greenhouse.io/jobs/req-8342

Actions requested: 
1) Markus: please approve the requisition to create the job in Greenhouse (cost center and band are on the attached form).
2) Laura: confirm we can reallocate the vacancy to EU cost center (or advise finance approver).
3) Marissa: confirm interview panel + two preferred slot windows next week for scheduling.

If I get approvals today I can create the req and send calendar invites for screen + onsite slate.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorize EU inference backfill — req creation and interview slate

Thanks Naomi — quick questions before I give final go-ahead: 
- Which cost center will this draw from? Confirming FY26 hiring plan alignment is needed.
- Expected total comp band (on-target) and a hiring cap that Marissa is comfortable with.
- Who are the proposed interviewers (names + conflicts)? I want to ensure we have manager + cross-functional coverage (Platform, SRE, Product).

Marissa — are you aligned to the timeline Naomi suggested? If recruiting can promise a 4–6 week cycle, I'm ok to greenlight pending finance confirmation. Laura, can you confirm reallocation or advise next approver?

Markus
VP, Serving Runtime
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, acme-talent@recruiters.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorize EU inference backfill — req creation and interview slate

Thanks Markus — answers below: 
- Cost center: EU Infra (CC: EU-OPS-03). Attached headcount form lists the transfer from global infra pool; Laura, please confirm if a manual reallocation is required or if we can proceed under the existing approval envelope.
- Band: target on-target comp bracket: $220k–$280k (USD terms equivalent) — we recommend keeping offers below $275k for initial slate. Hiring cap set to $290k if we need stretch for an exceptional profile.
- Proposed interviewers: 
  - Marissa Cole (Hiring manager — Serving Runtime)
  - Steph Nguyen (SRE lead — infra reliability)
  - Jonas Weber (Platform PM) — I will reach out separately for availability
  - Technical peer: Markus Klein (VP) — 30m final
  - Recruiter screen: Acme Talent / Naomi initial 30m screen

Pipeline / scheduling: Acme Talent has one near-term candidate (Alex C.) who completed an initial phone screen and is available for a technical screen on Tue 8/25 or Wed 8/26 (EU afternoon / US morning windows). I attached the candidate pack (resume + takehome summary).

If I receive finance confirmation and Markus's sign-off today I will create the req in Greenhouse and kick off scheduling for next week.

Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorize EU inference backfill — req creation and interview slate

I support moving forward. A couple of notes: 
- Band looks right for the market; comfortable with $275k cap for the initial offer. If we see a must-have candidate, escalate to Markus for stretch approval.
- Please reserve the following interview slots (EU-friendly): Mon 8/31 14:00–17:00 CET, Tue 9/1 09:00–12:00 CET. I'll block tentative panels once the Greenhouse req exists.
- For panel composition: prioritize a deep-serving runtime problem (60m technical), a systems design + deployment focused session (45m), and a 30m culture/leadership behavioral.

Marissa
Head of Serving Runtime
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — confirming approvals: Markus (conditional on finance), Marissa (hiring timeline and panel) — Laura, can you confirm reallocation to CC EU-OPS-03 by EOD?

Next steps (I will action today):
- Create Greenhouse req (req-8342) and publish the public-facing JD. Link: https://redwood.greenhouse.io/jobs/req-8342
- Send calendar holds for Marissa's requested slots and proposed interviewers; finalize panel once Jonas confirms availability.
- Schedule Acme Talent's candidate (Alex C.) for a 30m technical screen on Tue 8/25 09:00 CET if we get final finance confirmation.

If Laura confirms the cost center transfer, consider this the formal greenlight to create the req.

Naomi
